fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices AMD rose 2.7% in pre-market trading following positive sentiment across the semiconductor sector after Nvidia's strong results ($115.8 billion revenue, exceeding consensus $109 billion).
fields.summary_ko.1: AMD completed the acquisition of AI inference chip design company Taalas for approximately $2.9 billion, securing 'Hardcore Models' semiconductor architecture technology to strengthen competitiveness against Nvidia.
fields.summary_ko.2: AMD's data center business revenue reached $8.5 billion, up 97% year-over-year, maintaining growth momentum.
